court: In the High Court of Madras†
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. A. Robinson, Government Advocate (Crl. side)
prayer: Prayer: Criminal Original petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C, to direct respondents 1 and 2 to take appropriate action under Section 133 of Cr.P.C. for removal of obstruction and encroachment made within Chellathalkulam Tank Water body in particularly on S. No. 129(2), 195(N) of Pirampatty Village and complete the same within the time stipulated by this Court.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.R. Swaminathan, J.:— The petitioner's grievance is that the local panchayat wanted to lay a road across the water body. He therefore wanted the Executive Magistrate to take action under Section 133 of Cr.P.C. To this effect, this criminal original petition has been filed.

2. The criminal original petition was filed way back in the year 2015. We are now in December 2019.

3. When the case was taken up for final disposal, it was submitted that the road had already been laid. Therefore, nothing survives for further adjudication in this criminal original petition. It is for the petitioner to take appropriate proceedings in the manner known to law. Preserving the petitioner's rights, the criminal original petition stands closed.
